title: Kuélap
summary: Kuélap is a walled stone citadel of the Chachapoya people on a limestone promontory about 3,000 m above sea level in Amazonas, northern Peru. Its perimeter wall is 10 to 20 m high and the citadel is about 584 m long. Andina dates its construction to the 11th to 16th centuries.

uncertainty.note: Andina: built between the 11th and 16th centuries AD. Mincetur dates the occupation from about the 5th century to the early Spanish presence in the 16th, so the start is uncertain.
